version.body: # Trip plan: Lisbon Five days in Lisbon, November 14 to 18. Flights are held, not booked: **nothing is paid yet**. The hotel moved to Alfama, closer to the walks. ## Flights | Leg | Flight | Departs | Arrives | Price | | --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | | SFO → LIS | TP 238 | Nov 13, 19:05 | Nov 14, 09:40 | $612 | | LIS → SFO | TP 237 | Nov 18, 12:30 | Nov 18, 16:15 | $598 | ## Hotel > Memmo Alfama, four nights, 189 EUR a night with breakfast. Free cancellation until November 10. The booking page is [on the hotel site](https://hotel.example.com/alfama). The old plan is in [version 2](#/docs/1?version=2). ## Days ### Thursday, November 14 - Morning: land at 09:40 and take the metro to the hotel. - Lunch near Alfama, about 25 EUR for two. - Afternoon: one free block, so the day never feels packed. - Evening: dinner at a small fish place. ### Friday, November 15 - Morning: walk to the old town. - Lunch near Alfama, about 25 EUR for two. - Afternoon: one free block, so the day never feels packed. - Evening: dinner at the rooftop bar. ### Saturday, November 16 - Morning: walk to the river front. - Lunch near Alfama, about 25 EUR for two. - Afternoon: one free block, so the day never feels packed. - Evening: dinner at a fado house. ### Sunday, November 17 - Morning: walk to the market. - Lunch near Alfama, about 25 EUR for two. - Afternoon: one free block, so the day never feels packed. - Evening: dinner at the bakery café. ### Monday, November 18 - Morning: walk to the tile museum. - Lunch near Alfama, about 25 EUR for two. - Afternoon: one free block, so the day never feels packed. - Evening: dinner at the airport. ## Packing 1. A light rain jacket: November has rain on about ten days. 2. Walking shoes, because the hills are steep. 3. A travel adapter (type F). ## Checks before you go - [ ] Book the flights before the hold ends on October 25. - [ ] Tell the bank about the trip. - [x] Passport is valid until 2029. ## Notes A very long word to test wrapping: Lisbonpublictransportdaypasswithunlimitedmetroandtramridesfortwentyfourhours.
